name: vacuum_cost_delay
description: Delay in milliseconds between vacuum cost units to throttle resource consumption during VACUUM operations.
symptoms: High I/O or CPU usage during vacuum
Vacuum starvation leading to bloat growth
tuning_tips: Start with 10–20 ms on busy systems to reduce I/O impact; increase only if autovacuum is still too aggressive, but avoid values > 50 ms unless under extreme load pressure.
